expectations.source_locator: L2095 CH-03 目標使用者、JTBD、痛點、成果、成功指標與產品驗收
expectations.user_goal: 使用者能用自然語言描述目標，系統保留原意到 release
expectations.expected_behavior: Natural task intake preserves intent/non-goals through PRD→arch→TaskSpec without intent loss
expectations.expected_experience: user states goal; system routes automatically; user not required to know WP/RBWI/AGENT/SKILL names
expectations.manual_intervention_expectation: none for normal tasks; only blocking questions or source-allowed HITL

expectations.user_goal: 知識工作台可讀可用；Obsidian 依 source disposition
expectations.expected_behavior: Git Markdown/Wiki human-readable workflow; Obsidian OPTIONAL/TIER-2/PLANNED - no false ACTIVE claim
expectations.expected_experience: user reads knowledge in human-readable markdown; Obsidian optional add-on
expectations.manual_intervention_expectation: none for core operation; Obsidian enablement is optional path

expectations.source_locator: REQ-034 INTENT 成功不是文件數或 Agent 數，而是原意到 release 的閉環品質
expectations.user_goal: 閉環品質：原意到 release 不流失、可恢復、錯誤成本下降
expectations.expected_behavior: first-pass acceptance; hidden rework minimized; recovery/resume transparent to user
expectations.expected_experience: user sees task complete with evidence; failures self-repair and resume
expectations.manual_intervention_expectation: none for recoverable failure; checkpoint/resume automatic

expectations.source_locator: REQ-035 NEED 使用者能判斷 HG-KSEOS 是否真正降低需求遺漏、手動整合、返工、誤發布與 Provider lock-in
expectations.user_goal: 降低手動整合、返工、誤發布、Provider lock-in
expectations.expected_behavior: automatic provider/tool selection with graceful fallback; no unnecessary manual shell work
expectations.expected_experience: user describes goal + provides inputs; system picks provider/tool; fallback transparent

expectations.source_locator: PRE-19 Context Engineering and Memory Governance
expectations.user_goal: 歷史相關任務自動 recall；無關任務不注入 Memory
expectations.expected_behavior: automatic relevant memory recall with scope/TTL/permission/provenance; no irrelevant injection
expectations.expected_experience: user does not say 'use memory'; recall happens only when relevant

expectations.user_goal: source-backed 問題自動 RAG；不足證據 abstain；不必要不跑 KG
expectations.expected_behavior: automatic RAG when needed with citation/grounding; abstain when insufficient; KG only when relationship useful
expectations.expected_experience: user asks question; system retrieves, cites, or abstains honestly

expectations.user_goal: 任務自動選既有 Skill；無 match 走 FIT-GAP；skill 學習受治理
expectations.expected_behavior: automatic existing-skill selection; no-fit → FIT-GAP/reuse search; governed SkillCandidate with qualification
expectations.expected_experience: user gets capability without naming a skill; system reuses proven skills

expectations.user_goal: secret/PII 不洩漏；高風險才 HITL；普通任務不被打斷
expectations.expected_behavior: secret/PII not leaked/persisted; high-risk → HITL; normal low-risk → no unnecessary HITL
expectations.expected_experience: user not asked unnecessary questions; credentials handled by HITL when truly needed

expectations.user_goal: 重複工作模式受治理學習；學習不得覆寫 authority
expectations.expected_behavior: governed learning signal → MemoryCandidate/SkillCandidate with tests+negative+holdout+checker; learning cannot overwrite authority
expectations.expected_experience: system improves over repeated work without user managing promotion

expectations.source_locator: User Guide sections (task entry, automatic choices, HITL)
expectations.user_goal: 使用者能按 User Guide 完成日常任務
expectations.expected_behavior: guide matches actual runtime; user knows what to type and what happens automatically
expectations.expected_experience: user describes goal + inputs; understands automatic internal choices from guide

expectations.expected_behavior: failure classify → checkpoint → smallest repair → affected recheck → independent verify → resume → user-visible completion
expectations.expected_experience: user sees completion despite transient failures; no hidden rework

expectations.user_goal: 知識工作台以 Git Markdown/Wiki 為基礎，Obsidian 為 OPTIONAL
expectations.expected_behavior: Git Markdown Wiki + LLM Wiki compiler + KnowledgePack publication human-readable; Obsidian OPTIONAL_NOT_ACTIVE_SOURCE_BACKED
expectations.expected_experience: knowledge browsable as markdown; obsidian not required

expectations.source_locator: PRE-16 Bounded Agent Topology、TaskDAG and A2A
expectations.user_goal: 簡單任務單一 agent；複雜獨立任務才 bounded multi-agent
expectations.expected_behavior: simple task → single-agent default; complex independent task → bounded multi-agent admission; no unnecessary delegation
expectations.expected_experience: user unaware of agent topology for simple tasks

expectations.user_goal: 最終結果以人類可理解語言呈現，不需內部工程知識
expectations.expected_behavior: final result understandable without internal engineering knowledge; failure explanation + next action
expectations.expected_experience: user understands outcome, status, and next action

expectations.user_goal: withdrawn/stale source 不再被檢索到；不產生幻覺引用
expectations.expected_behavior: withdrawn/stale source invalidated → rebuild → no stale retrieval/edge; abstain instead of hallucinated citation
expectations.expected_experience: user never sees stale/withdrawn content or fabricated citations

expectations.user_goal: admitted provider/tool 自動選擇；未 admission 不自動路由
expectations.expected_behavior: automatic selection among admitted providers/tools; unadmitted provider/tool auto-route = FAIL (negative)
